items.title: Microsoft lets advertisers set up to 40 guidelines for AI-written ads
items.excerpt: Conversions API leaves its per-account pilot with 10 named partners, and Performance Max adds search term reports. Landing page data follows from mid-November.

items.title: Advertisers in 10 more countries can't opt out of Google's AI Mode ads
items.excerpt: Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns in India, Kenya and 8 more markets now enter AI Mode. Brazil and Mexico, due in Q4, test the English-only list.

items.title: US Alexa for Shopping users spend 50% more per order, Amazon says
items.excerpt: Over 400 million customers used the assistant in 12 months, where US advertisers pay for prompts. Jassy says outside AI agents barely dent ads. For how long?

items.title: Shopify Now Lets Stores Pay The Company Behind Your AI Shopping Agent
items.excerpt: Shopify pays the company behind an AI agent 0.3% of promoted-product orders, and stores can add more. Here is what that commission changes.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads Turns On Automatic Ad Changes By Default
items.excerpt: Creative enhancements are now on by default in ChatGPT Ads. Here's what they can change, how to opt out, and the tracking questions still open.

items.title: Google Says Changing tCPA & Budgets Won’t Reset Learning – 6 BFCM Takeaways
items.excerpt: Google’s Tal Akabas says changing tCPA, tROAS, or budgets on steady-state campaigns won’t trigger Learning - read why to skip seasonality adjustments.

items.title: OpenAI's ChatGPT Gets Wider Ads, Multi-Image Ads Expands, Expansion & More
items.excerpt: OpenAI just sent its weekly email update to advertisers announcing the ChatGPT Ads are live in 26 more countries, a new wider standard ad unit format, Multi-image ads are now available in open beta to all advertisers, Shopify integration is now available internationally and Shopify integration is now available internationally.

items.title: Microsoft Bing Showing Ads Within Copilot AI Overviews
items.excerpt: Microsoft is now showing ads within the Bing AI Overviews powered by Copilot.  I don't think I've seen ads within the AI responses in Bing Search and I personally still cannot trigger them, but Khushal Bherwani shared a screenshot of an ad within an AI Overview in Bing Search.

items.title: Amazon’s Ads nears $20 billion in Q3 as it bets on agentic AI to fuel further growth
items.excerpt: mazon Ads Agent will spearhead the company’s media offering, but its growing control over media buying sparks transparency concerns.

items.title: DoorDash said it's only received 'several hundred' orders from AI agents
items.excerpt: DoorDash said that it is open to working with third-party agent makers.

items.title: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru
items.excerpt: Starbucks wants to bring AI to its app, too.

items.title: 줄라이하우스, 배우 디지털 초상 AI 광고 플랫폼 ‘클링크(CLYNK)’ 오픈
items.excerpt: AI IP·플랫폼 기업 줄라이하우스(대표 정의석)가 배우의 디지털 초상을 활용한 AI 광고 제작 플랫폼 ‘클링크(CLYNK)’를 오픈했다. 클링크는 광고주와 배우 등 IP 권리자, AI 크리에이터를 하나로 연결...
